main_measure.name: t-statistic of the pooled slope of 72-bar drift-adjusted forward return on the forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with per-coin check passing; reject t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: coins with a positive per-coin slope (need >= 4 of 6)

decided_by: Pooled slope t >= 2 and the slope is positive for at least 4 of the 6 coins.
reading: Regression is OLS with intercept on all grid cases (forecast at the grid bar, zero forecasts included) with drift = the coin's mean non-overlapping 72-bar grid return over all its windows; the per-coin check counts coins with a positive slope against the fixed requirement of 4; grid cells without a full 72-bar forward return in the window are dropped.
